summary: CKGSB’s global marketing team is in a critical push to finalise Asia Start video assets and lock down Intelligent China program details while managing a time-sensitive email account lockout and advancing the knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: The top priority this week is completing the Asia Start video edits—fixing the mouth/voice sync, enlarging lower thirds, and sharing the final cuts with Ira today—and ensuring Alan and the Global Programs team deliver sufficiently detailed Intelligent China program information for marketing and sales. Urgent operational issues include resolving the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding the account with the new password on all devices, and confirming the rewrite of the Custom Program page. Major initiatives in motion are the knowledge website redesign (keeping the current design but incorporating Joseph’s elements, adding BCI/BSI indices, and removing the videos panel) and the marketing strategy that prioritises Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and conversion tracking, with Berkeley as a secondary focus. Upcoming milestones include the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum call on Tuesday and agenda discussion, finalising the Li Wei article translation, and sharing the updated homepage design mockup with Ira.
